description: HR-49 is the specific registration code for Kalka sub-division in the Panchkula district of Haryana. It operates as a Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, primarily handling non-transport vehicle registrations and licensing for the region. This office is significant due to its location as a major transit point between the plains of Haryana and the hilly regions of Himachal Pradesh.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Kalka, District Panchkula, Haryana
